title: Wing Anti-Ice Selection and Fault Indication — Crew Procedure

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Ice and Rain Protection — Airfoil Anti-Ice

abstract: Crew procedure for wing anti-ice selection and for the fault indication that can appear at the first selection of the day, including when the selection may be repeated and when it may not.

sections.purpose: Gives the flight crew the wing anti-ice selection procedure and the actions to take if a fault indication appears at or shortly after the first selection.
sections.description: Wing anti-ice is selected by the crew and protects the leading edge of the outboard slats. The selection is normally made before entering icing conditions and the system takes a short time to become fully effective, which the crew see as the indication changing from selected to on. A fault indication at the first selection after the aircraft has been parked in freezing conditions overnight has been reported on a number of aircraft and in most cases the system becomes available on a second selection or after the airframe has warmed. The indication is not distinguishable from a genuine failure at the time it appears, so the crew treat it the same way and repeat the selection once. Where the indication persists after the second selection, the system is treated as unavailable on that side and the icing restrictions apply. The crew must not repeat the selection more than once, because a repeated cycle on a system that is genuinely failed can mask the failure from the maintenance record.
sections.crew_procedure: Select wing anti-ice before entering icing conditions and confirm the indication changes from selected to on. If a fault indication appears at the first selection after a cold night stop, deselect, wait for the interval in the operations manual and select once again. If the indication clears, continue normally and record the occurrence in the technical log. If the indication persists, deselect on the affected side, apply the icing restrictions for one side unavailable and record the occurrence. Do not cycle the selection more than once.

type_data.section_title: Normal and Abnormal Procedures — Ice Protection
type_data.crew_action: Repeat the selection once; if the indication persists, treat the side as unavailable and apply the icing restrictions.
